dedupe_keys.name: vehicle to vehicle flooding datasets using mk5 on board unit devices

description: Vehicle-to-Vehicle Flooding Datasets using MK5 On-board Unit Devices is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Breno Sousa et al. The availability of information is a key requirement for the proper functioning of any network. When the availability problem is brought to vehicular networks, it may hinder novel vehicular services and applications and potentially put human lives at risk, as malicious users can send a massive number of spurious packets to disrupt them. Coverage: not stated; published in 2024. Formats: Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
